message.content:
Here are the best websites to find **free 3D game assets** in 2026, organized by category:

---

## **All-Rounders (Models, Textures, Audio)**

| Site | What You'll Find | License |
|------|----------------|---------|
| **itch.io** | Complete game kits, 2D sprites, 3D models, audio, pixel art | Mostly CC0 |
| **OpenGameArt.org** | Massive collection of 2D art, 3D models, music, sound effects | CC0, CC-BY, GPL |
| **Kenney** | 40,000+ consistent-style assets (2D, 3D, UI, fonts, audio) | CC0 |

---

## **3D Models**

| Site | Specialty | License |
|------|-----------|---------|
| **Quaternius** | Stylized low-poly characters, animals, vehicles, environments, weapons (rigged & animated) | CC0 |
| **Poly Haven** | Realistic props, environmental pieces, HDRIs | CC0 |
| **Sketchfab** | Huge variety of game-ready characters, props, environments | CC0 / CC-BY (check per model) |
| **Mixamo** | Rigged characters + motion-captured animations (walks, runs, combat, idles) | Free commercial use |
| **Meshy** | 6,870+ AI-generated game models in STL, GLB, FBX, OBJ formats | CC0 |
| **PolyScann** | Buildings, medieval props, industrial assets, game-ready content | CC0 |
| **Open3DModel** | 595+ game characters, consoles, environments, chess sets | Free (varies) |
| **3DExport** | Game-ready models (low-poly, PBR, stylized) | Free / Paid |

---

## **Textures & Materials (PBR)**

| Site | What You'll Find | License |
|------|----------------|---------|
| **ambientCG** | 2,000+ PBR materials with albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, height, AO maps (up to 8K/16K) | CC0 |
| **CGBookcase** | High-quality PBR textures + tutorials | CC0 |
| **FreeStylized** | 150+ stylized 4K textures, skyboxes/HDRI, asset packs with LODs | Free |
| **Poly Haven** | Photorealistic PBR materials | CC0 |

---

## **Audio (Music & SFX)**

| Site | What You'll Find | License |
|------|----------------|---------|
| **Freesound** | 600,000+ sound effects, ambient audio, foley | CC0 available |
| **Sonniss GDC Bundles** | Professional-grade sound effects (years of GDC giveaways) | Royalty-free, commercial use |
| **Pixabay** | Sound effects and background music | CC0-equivalent |

---

## **Quick Tips**

- **CC0 = Public domain** — use commercially, no attribution needed
- **CC-BY = Attribution required** — credit the creator
- Most sites offer **FBX, OBJ, GLB/GLTF** formats compatible with Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, and Blender
- Many assets include **PBR textures** and **LODs** (Level of Detail) for game optimization

---

Sources:

3. https://freestylized.com/
4. https://assethoard.com/blog/where-to-find-free-game-assets-2026
5. https://www.rankred.com/download-free-stl-files-3d-printing/
6. https://polyscann.com/blog/post/best-free-3d-assets-for-unity-2026
7. https://open3dmodel.com/3d-models/game-character

9. https://open3dmodel.com/3d-models/game-console
